The Material

It begins with wood.

We work primarily with solid teak — a material known for its strength, warmth, and natural character. We don't try to make every piece look identical. The grain, tone, and small variations are part of what makes each object its own.

Solid Teak Natural Character Built To Last
From Jepara

Born in Jepara. Made for the world.

Jepara has a long relationship with furniture craftsmanship. At Zakajati, that heritage becomes the foundation — combined with a contemporary approach to form, proportion, material, and space.

Craftsmanship

Made by hand. Refined by time.

A piece of furniture is not finished when it takes shape. It is finished when every proportion, joint, surface, and detail feels right.

  • 01
    Select
    We begin with material suited to the character and requirements of the piece.
  • 02
    Shape
    Each component is shaped according to its intended proportion and function.
  • 03
    Join
    Structure comes together through carefully considered connections.
  • 04
    Sand
    Surfaces are refined to reveal the natural character of the wood.
  • 05
    Finish
    The final treatment brings out the material while protecting the piece.
  • 06
    Inspect
    Every piece goes through a final check before it leaves the workshop.

FAQ

A few things worth knowing.

Can I request custom dimensions?

Yes. Furniture can be developed around project dimensions and requirements.

Do you work with architects and interior designers?

Yes. We can work from references, drawings, specifications, or design directions.

Can I request a specific finish?

Finish can be discussed based on the desired appearance and project requirements.

What types of projects do you handle?

We work across hospitality, restaurants, cafés, villas, commercial spaces, and selected residential projects.

Can I order multiple pieces for a project?

Yes. Project-based production can be discussed according to quantity and requirements.

How do I start?

Send us your project details, references, approximate quantity, and location through WhatsApp.
